# box smooth 15x15 via cumsum
def box(x,k):
    c=np.cumsum(np.cumsum(x,0),1)
    c=np.pad(c,((1,0),(1,0)))
    H,W=x.shape
    out=c[k:,k:]-c[:-k,k:]-c[k:,:-k]+c[:-k,:-k]
    return out/(k*k)

    sub=ds[i*H//gy:(i+1)*H//gy, j*W//gx:(j+1)*W//gx]
    mapim[i,j]=sub.max()
mx=mapim.max()
